ayahs.1: Logon ke hisaab ka waqt qareeb aa gaya, phir bhi woh be-khabari mein munh phere hue hain.
ayahs.2: Un ke paas un ke Rabb ki taraf se jo bhi nayi nayi naseehat aati hai, use woh khel kood mein hi sunte hain.
ayahs.3: Un ke dil bilkul ghaafil hain aur un zaalimon ne chupke chupke sargoshiyan kin ke woh tum hi jaisa insan hai, phir kya wajah hai jo tum aankhon dekhte jaadu mein aa jaate ho.
ayahs.4: Paighambar ne kaha, mera Parwardigar har us baat ko jo zameen-o-aasman mein hai ba-khoobi jaanta hai, woh bahut hi sunne wala aur jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.5: Itna hi nahin balke yeh to kehte hain ke yeh Quran paraaganda khwabon ka majmooa hai, balke us ne az-khud use ghad liya hai, balke yeh shaayar hai, warna hamare saamne yeh koi aisi nishani laate jaise ke agle paighambar bheje gaye the.
ayahs.6: Un se pehle jitni bastiyan hum ne ujaadin, sab imaan se khaali thin, to kya ab yeh imaan laayenge?
ayahs.7: Tujh se pehle jitne paighambar hum ne bheje sabhi mard the jin ki taraf hum wahi utaarte the, pas tum ahl-e-kitaab se poochh lo agar khud tumhein ilm na ho.
ayahs.8: Hum ne un ke aise jism nahin banaaye the ke woh khaana na khaayen aur na woh hamesha rehne wale the.
ayahs.9: Phir hum ne un se kiye hue sab waade sachche kiye, unhein aur jin jin ko hum ne chaaha najaat ata farmaayi aur hadd se nikal jaane walon ko ghaarat kar diya.
ayahs.10: Yaqeenan hum ne tumhari jaanib kitaab naazil farmaayi hai jis mein tumhare liye zikr hai, kya phir bhi tum aqal nahin rakhte?
ayahs.11: Aur bahut si bastiyan hum ne tabaah kar din jo zaalim thin aur un ke baad hum ne doosri qaum ko paida kar diya.
ayahs.12: Jab unhon ne hamare azaab ka ehsaas kar liya to lage us se bhaagne.
ayahs.13: Bhaag daud na karo aur jahan tumhein aasoodgi di gayi thi wahin waapas lauto aur apne makanaat ki taraf jaao taake tum se sawaal to kar liya jaaye.
ayahs.14: Kehne lage haaye hamari kharaabi! Beshak hum zaalim the.
ayahs.15: Phir to un ka yehi qaul tha yahan tak ke hum ne unhein jad se kati hui kheti aur bujhi padi aag (ki tarah) kar diya.
ayahs.16: Hum ne aasman-o-zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki cheezon ko khelte hue nahin banaaya.
ayahs.17: Agar hum yun hi khel tamaashe ka irada karte to use apne paas se hi bana lete, agar hum karne wale hi hote.
ayahs.18: Balke hum sach ko jhoot par phenk maarte hain, pas sach jhoot ka sar tod deta hai aur woh usi waqt naabood ho jaata hai, tum jo baaten banaate ho woh tumhari liye baais-e-kharaabi hain.
ayahs.19: Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo hai usi Allah ka hai aur jo is ke paas hain woh is ki ibaadat se na sarkashi karte hain aur na thakte hain.
ayahs.20: Woh din raat tasbeeh bayan karte hain aur zara si bhi susti nahin karte.
ayahs.21: Kya un logon ne zameen (ki makhlooqaat mein) se jinhein mabood bana rakha hai woh zinda kar dete hain?
ayahs.22: Agar aasman-o-zameen mein siwaaye Allah Taala ke aur bhi mabood hote to yeh donon darham-barham hojaate, pas Allah Taala arsh ka Rabb har us wasf se paak hai jo yeh mushrik bayan karte hain.
ayahs.23: Woh apne kaamon ke liye (kisi ke aage) jawab-deh nahin aur sab (us ke aage) jawab-deh hain.
ayahs.24: Kya un logon ne Allah ke siwa aur mabood bana rakhe hain, un se keh do laao apni daleel pesh karo. Yeh hai mere saath walon ki kitaab aur mujh se aglon ki daleel. Baat yeh hai ke un mein ke aksar log haq ko nahin jaante, isi wajah se munh mode hue hain.
ayahs.25: Tujh se pehle bhi jo Rasool hum ne bheja us ki taraf yehi wahi naazil farmaayi ke mere siwa koi mabood bar-haq nahin, pas tum sab meri hi ibaadat karo.
ayahs.26: (Mushrik log) kehte hain ke Rahman aulaad wala hai (ghalat hai) us ki zaat paak hai, balke woh sab us ke ba-izzat bande hain.
ayahs.27: Kisi baat mein Allah par pesh-dasti nahin karte, balke us ke farmaan par kaarband hain.
ayahs.28: Woh un ke aage peechhe tamaam umoor se waaqif hai, woh kisi ki bhi sifaarish nahin karte bajz un ke jin se Allah khush ho, woh to khud haibat-e-Ilahi se larzaan-o-tarsaan hain.
ayahs.29: Un mein se agar koi bhi keh de ke Allah ke siwa main laayeq-e-ibaadat hoon to hum use dozakh ki saza den, hum zaalimon ko isi tarah saza dete hain.
ayahs.30: Kya kaafir logon ne yeh nahin dekha ke aasman-o-zameen baaham mile jule the, phir hum ne unhein juda kiya aur har zinda cheez ko hum ne paani se paida kiya, kya yeh log phir bhi imaan nahin laate?
ayahs.31: Aur hum ne zameen mein pahaad bana diye taake woh makhlooq ko hila na sake, aur hum ne us mein kushaada raahen bana din taake woh raasta haasil karen.
ayahs.32: Aasman ko mahfooz chhat bhi hum ne hi banaaya hai, lekin log us ki qudrat ke namoonon par dhyaan nahin dharte.
ayahs.33: Wahi Allah hai jis ne raat aur din aur sooraj aur chaand ko paida kiya hai, in mein se har ek apne apne madaar mein tairte phirte hain.
ayahs.34: Aap se pehle kisi insan ko bhi hum ne hameshgi nahin di, kya agar aap mar gaye to woh hamesha ke liye reh jaayenge?
ayahs.35: Har jaan-daar maut ka maza chakhne wala hai, hum ba-tareeq-e-imtihaan tum mein se har ek ko buraai bhalaai mein mubtala karte hain aur tum sab hamari hi taraf lautaaye jaao ge.
ayahs.36: Yeh munkireen tujhe jab bhi dekhte hain to tumhara mazaaq hi udaate hain ke kya yehi woh hai jo tumhare mabudon ka zikr buraai se karta hai, aur woh khud hi Rahman ki yaad ke bilkul hi munkir hain.
ayahs.37: Insan jald-baaz makhlooq hai, main tumhein apni nishaaniyan abhi abhi dikhaaoon ga, tum mujh se jald-baazi na karo.
ayahs.38: Kehte hain ke agar sachche ho to bata do ke yeh wada kab hai.
ayahs.39: Kaash! Yeh kaafir jaante ke us waqt na to yeh kaafir aag ko apne chehron se hata sakenge aur na apni peethon se aur na un ki madad ki jaayegi.
ayahs.40: (Haan haan!) Wade ki ghadi un ke paas achaanak aa jaayegi aur unhein haka-baka kar degi, phir na to yeh log use taal sakenge aur na zara si bhi mohlat diye jaayenge.
ayahs.41: Aur tujh se pehle Rasoolon ke saath bhi hansi-mazaaq kiya gaya, pas hansi karne walon ko hi us cheez ne gher liya jis ki woh hansi udaate the.
ayahs.42: Un se poochhiye ke Rahman se, din aur raat tumhari hifaazat kaun kar sakta hai? Baat yeh hai ke yeh log apne Rabb ke zikr se phire hue hain.
ayahs.43: Kya hamare siwa un ke aur mabood hain jo unhein museebaton se bacha len? Koi bhi khud apni madad ki taaqat nahin rakhta aur na koi hamari taraf se rafaaqat diya jaata hai.
ayahs.44: Balke hum ne unhein aur un ke baap dadon ko zindagi ke saro-saamaan diye, yahan tak ke un ki muddat-e-umr guzar gayi. Kya woh nahin dekhte ke hum zameen ko us ke kinaaron se ghataate chale aa rahe hain, ab kya wahi ghaalib hain?
ayahs.45: Keh dijiye! Main to tumhein Allah ki wahi ke zariye aagah kar raha hoon, magar behre log baat nahin sunte jab ke unhein aagah kiya jaaye.
ayahs.46: Agar unhein tere Rabb ke kisi azaab ka jhonka bhi lag jaaye to pukar uthen ke haaye hamari badbakhti! Yaqeenan hum gunahgaar the.
ayahs.47: Qayamat ke din hum darmiyaan mein la rakhenge theek theek tolne wali taraazu ko. Phir kisi par kuchh bhi zulm na kiya jaayega. Aur agar ek raai ke daane ke baraabar bhi amal hoga hum use la-haazir karenge, aur hum kaafi hain hisaab karne wale.
ayahs.48: Yeh bilkul sach hai ke hum ne Moosa-o-Haaroon ko faisle karne wali nooraani aur parhezgaron ke liye waz-o-naseehat wali kitaab ata farmaayi.
ayahs.49: Woh log jo apne Rabb se bin dekhe khauf khaate hain aur qayamat (ke tasawwur) se kaanpte rehte hain.
ayahs.50: Aur yeh naseehat-o-barkat wala Quran bhi hum hi ne naazil farmaaya hai, kya phir bhi tum us ke munkir ho?
ayahs.51: Yaqeenan hum ne is se pehle Ibraheem ko us ki samajh-boojh bakhshi thi aur hum us ke ahwaal se ba-khoobi waaqif the.
ayahs.52: Jab ke us ne apne baap se aur apni qaum se kaha ke yeh moortiyan jin ke tum mujaawir bane baithe ho kya hain?
ayahs.53: Sab ne jawab diya ke hum ne apne baap dada ko inhi ki ibaadat karte hue paaya.
ayahs.54: Aap ne farmaya! Phir to tum aur tumhare baap dada sabhi yaqeenan khuli gumraahi mein mubtala rahe.
ayahs.55: Kehne lage kya aap hamare paas sach-much haq laaye hain ya yun hi mazaaq kar rahe hain?
ayahs.56: Aap ne farmaya nahin, dar-haqeeqat tum sab ka Parwardigar to woh hai jo aasmanon aur zameen ka maalik hai jis ne unhein paida kiya hai, main to isi baat ka gawah aur qaail hoon.
ayahs.57: Aur Allah ki qasam! Main tumhare in mabudon ke saath jab tum alaihda peeth pher kar chal doge ek chaal chaloon ga.
ayahs.58: Pas us ne un sab ke tukde tukde kar diye, haan sirf bade but ko chhod diya, yeh bhi is liye ke woh sab us ki taraf hi lauten.
ayahs.59: Kehne lage ke hamare khudaaon ke saath yeh kis ne kiya? Aisa shakhs to yaqeenan zaalimon mein se hai.
ayahs.60: Bole hum ne ek naujawaan ko un ka tazkira karte hue suna tha jise Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) kaha jaata hai.
ayahs.61: Sab ne kaha achcha use majma mein logon ki nigahon ke saamne lao taake sab dekhen.
ayahs.62: Kehne lage! Aye Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) kya tu ne hi hamare khudaaon ke saath yeh harkat ki hai?
ayahs.63: Aap ne jawab diya balke is kaam ko in ke bade ne kiya hai, tum apne khudaaon se hi poochh lo agar yeh bolte chaalte hon.
ayahs.64: Pas yeh log apne dilon mein qaail hogaye aur kehne lage waaqai zaalim to tum hi ho.
ayahs.65: Phir apne saron ke bal aundhe hogaye (aur kehne lage ke) yeh to tujhe bhi maloom hai ke yeh bolne chaalne wale nahin.
ayahs.66: Allah ke Khaleel ne usi waqt farmaya afsos! Kya tum Allah ke ilaawa un ki ibaadat karte ho jo na tumhein kuchh bhi nafa pahuncha saken na nuqsaan?
ayahs.67: Tuf hai tum par aur un par jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibaadat karte ho. Kya tumhein itni si aqal bhi nahin?
ayahs.68: Kehne lage ke use jala do aur apne khudaaon ki madad karo agar tumhein kuchh karna hi hai.
ayahs.69: Hum ne farma diya aye aag! Tu thandi pad ja aur Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ke liye salaamati (aur aaraam ki cheez) ban ja!
ayahs.70: Go unhon ne Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ka bura chaaha, lekin hum ne unhein naakaam bana diya.
ayahs.71: Aur hum Ibraheem aur Loot ko bacha kar us zameen ki taraf le chale jis mein hum ne tamaam jahaan walon ke liye barkat rakhi thi.
ayahs.72: Aur hum ne use Ishaaq ata farmaaya aur Yaqoob us par mazeed, aur har ek ko hum ne saalih banaaya.
ayahs.73: Aur hum ne unhein peshwa bana diya ke hamare hukm se logon ki rehbari karen, aur hum ne un ki taraf nek kaamon ke karne aur namazon ke qaaim rakhne aur zakaat dene ki wahi (talqeen) ki, aur woh sab ke sab hamare ibaadat-guzaar bande the.
ayahs.74: Hum ne Loot (alaihis salaam) ko bhi hukm aur ilm diya aur use usi basti se najaat di jahan ke log gande kaamon mein mubtala the, aur the bhi badtareen gunahgaar.
ayahs.75: Aur hum ne Loot (alaihis salaam) ko apni rahmat mein daakhil kar liya, be-shak woh neko-kaar logon mein se tha.
ayahs.76: Nooh ke us waqt ko yaad kijiye jab ke us ne is se pehle dua ki, hum ne us ki dua qubool farmaayi aur use aur us ke ghar walon ko bade karb se najaat di.
ayahs.77: Aur jo log hamari aayaton ko jhutla rahe the un ke muqaable mein hum ne us ki madad ki, yaqeenan woh bure log the, pas hum ne un sab ko dubo diya.
ayahs.78: Aur Daaood aur Sulaiman (alaihimas-salaam) ko yaad kijiye jab ke woh khet ke maamle mein faisla kar rahe the ke kuchh logon ki bakriyan raat ko us mein char-chag gayi thin, aur un ke faisle mein hum maujood the.
ayahs.79: Hum ne us ka saheeh faisla Sulaiman ko samjha diya. Haan har ek ko hum ne hukm-o-ilm de rakha tha aur Daaood ke taabe hum ne pahaad kar diye the jo tasbeeh karte the aur parind bhi, hum karne wale hi the.
ayahs.80: Aur hum ne use tumhare liye libaas banane ki kaarigari sikhaayi taake ladaai ke zarar se tumhara bachaao ho, kya tum shukr-guzaar bano ge?
ayahs.81: Hum ne tund-o-tez hawa ko Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ke taabe kar diya jo us ke farmaan ke mutaabiq us zameen ki taraf chalti thi jahan hum ne barkat de rakhi thi, aur hum har cheez se ba-khabar aur daana hain.
ayahs.82: Isi tarah se bahut se shayateen bhi hum ne us ke taabe kiye the jo us ke farmaan se ghote lagaate the aur us ke siwa bhi bahut se kaam karte the, un ke nigehbaan hum hi the.
ayahs.83: Ayyub (alaihis salaam) ki us haalat ko yaad karo jab ke us ne apne Parwardigar ko pukaara ke mujhe yeh bimaari lag gayi hai aur tu rahm karne walon se ziyaada rahm karne wala hai.
ayahs.84: To hum ne us ki sun li aur jo dukh unhein tha use door kar diya aur us ko ahl-o-ayaal ata farmaaye, balke un ke saath waise hi aur apni khaas mehrbani se, taake sachche bandon ke liye sabab-e-naseehat ho.
ayahs.85: Aur Ismaeel aur Idrees aur Zul-Kifl (alaihimus salaam), yeh sab saabir log the.
ayahs.86: Hum ne unhein apni rahmat mein daakhil kar liya, yeh sab log nek the.
ayahs.87: Machhli wale (Hazrat Yunus alaihis salaam) ko yaad karo! Jab ke woh ghusse se chal diya aur khayal kiya ke hum use na pakad sakenge. Bil-aakhir woh andheron ke andar se pukar utha ke Ilahi tere siwa koi mabood nahin, tu paak hai, beshak main zaalimon mein ho gaya.
ayahs.88: To hum ne us ki pukar sun li aur use gham se najaat de di aur hum imaan walon ko isi tarah bacha liya karte hain.
ayahs.89: Aur Zakariya (alaihis salaam) ko yaad karo jab us ne apne Rabb se dua ki ke aye mere Parwardigar! Mujhe tanha na chhod, tu sab se behtar waaris hai.
ayahs.90: Hum ne us ki dua ko qubool farma kar use Yahya (alaihis salaam) ata farmaaya aur un ki biwi ko un ke liye durust kar diya. Yeh buzurg log nek kaamon ki taraf jaldi karte the aur hamein laalach-o-tama aur dar-o-khauf se pukaarte the, aur hamare saamne aajizi karne wale the.
ayahs.91: Aur woh paak-daaman bibi jis ne apni ismat ki hifaazat ki, hum ne us ke andar rooh se phoonk di aur khud unhein aur un ke ladke ko tamaam jahaan ke liye nishani bana diya.
ayahs.92: Yeh tumhari ummat hai jo haqeeqat mein ek hi ummat hai, aur main tum sab ka Parwardigar hoon, pas tum meri hi ibaadat karo.
ayahs.93: Magar logon ne aapas mein apne deen mein firqa-bandiyan kar lin, sab ke sab hamari hi taraf lautne wale hain.
ayahs.94: Phir jo bhi nek amal kare aur woh momin (bhi) ho to us ki koshish ki be-qadri nahin ki jaayegi, hum to us ke likhne wale hain.
ayahs.95: Aur jis basti ko hum ne halaak kar diya us par laazim hai ke wahan ke log palat kar nahin aayenge.
ayahs.96: Yahan tak ke Yajooj aur Majooj khol diye jaayenge aur woh har bulandi se daudte hue aayenge.
ayahs.97: Aur sachcha wada qareeb aa lagega, us waqt kaafiron ki nigahen phati ki phati reh jaayengi, ke haaye afsos! Hum is haal se ghaafil the, balke fil-waqe hum qasoor-waar the.
ayahs.98: Tum aur Allah ke siwa jin jin ki tum ibaadat karte ho, sab dozakh ka indhan bano ge, tum sab dozakh mein jaane wale ho.
ayahs.99: Agar yeh (sachche) mabood hote to jahannam mein daakhil na hote, aur sab ke sab isi mein hamesha rehne wale hain.
ayahs.100: Woh wahan chilla rahe honge aur wahan kuchh bhi na sun sakenge.
ayahs.101: Albatta be-shak jin ke liye hamari taraf se neki pehle hi thehar chuki hai, woh sab jahannam se door hi rakhe jaayenge.
ayahs.102: Woh to dozakh ki aahat tak na sunenge aur apni man-bhaati cheezon mein hamesha rehne wale honge.
ayahs.103: Woh badi ghabraahat (bhi) unhein ghamgeen na kar sakegi aur farishte unhein haathon haath lenge, ke yehi tumhara woh din hai jis ka tum wada diye jaate rahe.
ayahs.104: Jis din hum aasman ko yun lapet lenge jaise tomaar mein auraq lapet diye jaate hain, jaise ke hum ne awwal dafa paidaish ki thi isi tarah dobaara karenge. Yeh hamare zimme wada hai aur hum use zaroor kar ke (hi) rahenge.
ayahs.105: Hum Zaboor mein pand-o-naseehat ke baad yeh likh chuke hain ke zameen ke waaris mere nek bande (hi) honge.
ayahs.106: Ibaadat-guzaar bandon ke liye to is mein ek bada paighaam hai.
ayahs.107: Aur hum ne aap ko tamaam jahaan walon ke liye rahmat bana kar hi bheja hai.
ayahs.108: Keh dijiye! Mere paas to pas wahi ki jaati hai ke tum sab ka mabood ek hi hai, to kya tum bhi us ki farmaanbardaari karne wale ho?
ayahs.109: Phir agar yeh munh mod len to keh dijiye ke main ne tumhein yaksaan taur par khabardaar kar diya hai. Mujhe ilm nahin ke jis ka wada tum se kiya ja raha hai woh qareeb hai ya door.
ayahs.110: Albatta Allah Taala to khuli aur zaahir baat ko bhi jaanta hai aur jo tum chhupaate ho use bhi jaanta hai.
ayahs.111: Mujhe is ka bhi ilm nahin, mumkin hai yeh tumhari aazmaaish ho aur ek muqarrara waqt tak ka faaida (pahunchaana) hai.
ayahs.112: Khud Nabi ne kaha aye Rabb! Insaaf ke saath faisla farma aur hamara Rabb bada mehrbaan hai jis se madad talab ki jaati hai un baaton par jo tum bayan karte ho.
